payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image background been changed so it reads as a basketball court?
node.criteria: complete: the background itself is recognizably a basketball court, supported by combined visible court cues such as court surface or markings and basketball equipment; a full court environment is not required. partial: the background has some visible progress toward a basketball court, such as basketball equipment or court markings, but the combined cues do not yet make it recognizably a court. absent: no visible progress toward changing the background to a basketball court. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress.
node.binding: The image background being replaced with a recognizable basketball court; assess visible court cues in the background, not merely a basketball-themed backdrop.

outcome.description: Change the image background into a basketball court.
